entities.summary: Rafael Ángel Ortega García is a Venezuelan professional baseball outfielder for the Toros de Tijuana of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Colorado Rockies, Los Angeles Angels, Miami Marlins, Atlanta Braves, Chicago Cubs, New York Mets, and Chicago White Sox.
